description:
When the model is reasoning/thinking, the Node.js version displays a 'Thinking...' indicator. This is completely missing in the Elixir version.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
No 'Thinking...' indicator appears during model reasoning

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
When model is processing, shows 'Thinking...' as a visual indicator before the model's response

This is important for UX so users know the model is actively reasoning, not frozen.
title: TUI-1: Missing 'Thinking...' indicator for model reasoning
